source.author: verg
source.text: Non te optima mater condet humi patrioque onerabit membra sepulchro:
source.text_original: Non te optima mater / condet humi patrioque onerabit membra sepulchro: /
source.text_english: Your best mother will not lay you in the earth and load your limbs with your ancestral tomb:

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: non Marte nec armis aut nati, precor, ille mei dignatus ut umquam ense cadat; quae fida manus, quae cara suorum diripiat laceretque senem nec membra sepulchro contegat.
reuse.text_original: non Marte nec armis / aut nati, precor, ille mei dignatus ut umquam / ense cadat; quae fida manus, quae cara suorum / diripiat laceretque senem nec membra sepulchro / contegat.
reuse.text_english: May he never be deemed worthy, I pray, to fall by the sword, neither by Mars nor by arms; what loyal hand, what beloved hand of his own people would tear to pieces and maul the old man, and not cover his limbs with a tomb?
